cohort: Pregnant women who were referred to Ayatollah Mousavi hospital of Zanjan for delivery in 2021
finding: Adolescent mothers were more likely to experience postpartum depression, and their babies were more likely to have low birth weight and low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common in the control group (adult mothers).
gest_age: Adolescent group: <19 years; Control group: 19-35 years
birth_weight: Significantly higher in infants born to mothers in the control group
